pages.text: The Soul Fruits expand the players default soul capacity when eaten. They have 3 different tiers and tier one is obtained from breaking Shadowwood Tree Leaves $(li)Tier 1 increases max capacity by 150 up to 1750!$(li)Tier 2 increases max capacity by 250 up to 4250!$(li)Tier 3 increases max capacity by 475 up to 7500!
